EM cycles for the graded response model

Source: R/14_grm.R
grm_em_fit.Rd

Runs Bock-Aitkin EM cycles from a starting point in target coding and stops when the item parameters move by less than tol (or after maxit cycles). The E-step is grm_em_estep_cpp(); the M-step solves each item's small expected-count problem with BFGS. Used by GRM().

Usage

grm_em_fit(
  target,
  dat,
  nitems,
  ncat,
  n_quad_points = 51,
  maxit = 500,
  tol = 1e-05,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

target

starting parameters in target coding

dat

integer response matrix coded 1..ncat with NA for missing

nitems

number of items

ncat

number of categories per item

n_quad_points

number of quadrature points

maxit

maximum number of EM cycles

tol

largest absolute change in any item parameter (slope or threshold) at which the cycles stop

verbose

print the marginal log-likelihood every ten cycles

Value

a list with the final target, the marginal loglik at the last E-step and the number of cycles
